content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Mark Herman, Harris County Constable Precinct 4's PostMark Herman, Harris County Constable Precinct 4April 4 at 5:30 PM · Shared with Public EASTER SUNDAY 2026: WHAT WILL BE OPEN?Here’s a quick list of stores in the area and their Easter Sunday hours: CLOSED:• H-E-B• ALDI• Sam’s Club• Costco• Target• Central Market OPEN:• Kroger (regular hours)• Trader Joe’s (regular hours)• Fiesta (regular hours)• Food Town (regular hours)• Walmart (open)• Sprouts: All stores open regular hours.• Whole Foods (hours may vary — check with your local store)• Academy Sports and Outdoors (open)Plan ahead, shop early, and have a safe and happy Easter!Follow us at Facebook.com/Precinct4, Instagram @Constablepct4 and download our mobile app "C4 NOW" to receive live feeds on crime, arrests, safety tips & traffic accidents in your area.All reactions:1.9K236 comments927 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Sukram JawnsawnChick Fil A is confirmed to be closed as well 1w80View all 6 repliesGinny KrauskopfThe pharmacy and other departments such as the deli will likely be closed.1w8Malaina OdomWalgreens is open regular hours!
